final_claim.accuracy: At this same t, (sum_X |tableMass(X)-1/card(Table r c)|)/2 <= 2^(-h).
final_claim.edge_cases: No positive dimension or positive margin assumption; empty dimensions and zero totals are included subject to equal totals.
final_claim.output: Every t-bit tape has halted with the literal row-major binary encoding of a Table r c.
final_claim.quantifiers: One fixed machine and global natural C>0,D, then all finite m,n, natural r,c with equal totals, and natural h>=1.

generic_reuse_boundary.allowed: Pinned parser, printer, polynomial arithmetic, dense sampler subroutines, and finite-word machine compiler are reused. Presence of generic library symbols does not substitute a different complete sampler.

runtime_boundary.intermediate_powers: 17 is the mixing allowance power; 85 and 170 are reservation/size bounds, not a complete numeric runtime exponent.
runtime_boundary.proof_only_choice: tableDraw uses Classical.choose as a specification witness; publicDraw and its realizer execute the computed ordinary list draw, not tableDraw.
runtime_boundary.proved: Uniform polynomial-time existence for this fixed formal fair-bit machine; supplied reserved-word draw cost plus output weight is separately polynomial.
runtime_boundary.supplied_bank_scope: Cost theorems take the exact scheduled bank, allow all natural h, and require no equal-total premise. Precision h is numeric in encodeMargins.length+h+3. The separate finite-word machine compiler accounts for fair-bit acquisition.
runtime_boundary.unextracted: The source witnesses complete Dtime=170*P.natDegree for an existential physical-compiler polynomial P. No concrete numeric full runtime degree is extracted here.
